stemMd: What is the function of the two public-meeting contributions?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They establish that the office used different counting methods.

options.label: B
options.textMd: They repeat the same objection about counting errors.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They identify different questions that the initial boarding data cannot resolve.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They supply final answers about permanent ridership.

explanationMd: The former user distinguishes trips from people; the employee questions temporal persistence. Their distinct concerns explain the survey and the extended trial.

distractorRationale.b: One concerns individual riders and the other the duration of demand.
distractorRationale.a: The passage states the same method was used.
distractorRationale.d: Neither contribution resolves permanence; they motivate more evidence.
